title: ErrorRecord
description: Matches src/Common/NewErrorRecord.ps1's New-EntraPostureErrorRecord output exactly (built in Phase 2) -- engineering plan section 11: sanitized structured record with stable error ID, stage, collector/control source, retryability, endpoint class, correlation ID, and safe diagnostic detail.

Source.description: Explicit null when no specific collector/control raised the error (e.g. a Build-stage error).

EndpointClass.description: Explicit null for non-transport errors (e.g. schema validation failures).

Message.description: Must pass Test-EntraPostureSafeDiagnosticText before this record is constructed -- enforced by New-EntraPostureErrorRecord itself, not re-validated by this schema (schema validation happens after construction, at serialization boundaries).
